Liberation War Affairs minister and spouse found Covid-19 positive
2020-06-12T22:01:10+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/coronavirus-deadly-new-threat/news/liberation-war-affairs-minister-and-spouse-found-covid-19-positive-1913325

Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Haque and his wife Laila Arjuman Banu tested positive for Covid-19 today, according to a press release issued by the ministry.

Habibur Rahman, personal secretary of the minister also tested positive for coronavirus today, the release added.

All three are currently being treated at their personal residences, the release added.

Their samples were collected yesterday for Covid-19 tests and the reports came back positive today.
